vision.name: Black Manipulative Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 life card of damage.
[Defense] POWER: Reveal a Styled attack card from your hand and play it to prevent all damage from an attack instead of as an attack.
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck to gain 2 stages and banish the top or bottom 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip sits below the art (read from a crop of the original); DR (alternate-art tier) number printed
